limitations: One complete integration comparison per model; not arbitrary-project certification.

An earlier diagnostic run exposed Context7 initialization timeout and model test-generation failures; errors were preserved and the full comparison rerun after startup recovery was fixed.
Throughput-only probes ran after other tests and downloads finished, in reverse model order; each used 256 output-token ceilings, thinking disabled, temperature 0, seed 42 and 16384 context tokens.

Server-reported VRAM allocations are not measurements of physical GPU usage.
Actual future Windows sign-in was not performed; the registered task entrypoint and forced termination behavior were tested directly.
Backups contain SQLite chat/state/indexed content, not original external files, model weights, source code or .env.
